title: C4 Therapeutics, Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-09
summary: C4 Therapeutics, Inc. entered into a Research Collaboration and License Agreement with F. Hoffmann-La Roche Ltd. and Hoffmann-La Roche Inc. to collaborate on the discovery, development, and commercialization of degrader-antibody conjugates (DACs) for cancer treatment. Roche will pay $20.0 million upfront with potential aggregate milestone payments exceeding $1.0 billion plus tiered royalties.
key_points: C4 Therapeutics signed a worldwide exclusive license agreement with Roche for DACs directed to two initial undisclosed oncology targets
Roche will make an upfront cash payment of $20.0 million
C4T is eligible to receive over $1.0 billion in aggregate development, regulatory and commercial milestone payments
Royalties payable from Roche to C4T range from mid-single digit to low-double digit percent
Roche is responsible for all development, regulatory approval, manufacturing and commercialization costs
Roche has an option to license DACs for one additional target within a specified period
